get.description: GetQuotaInfo returns aggregated quota info for all billing features of a tenant.

post.description: Reserve pre-allocates quota before task execution.
Commit finalizes the reservation with actual cost.
Release cancels a reservation and returns quota.

get.description: GetBalance returns current available and reserved quota for a single feature.

post.description: ConsumeCapped atomically consumes up to the available quota.

Persist the normal preparation intent, or service its resources phase.
 The existing handler reads at most64KiB, rejects unknown/trailing JSON,
 and accepts no caller-controlled amount, org, invoice or allowance window.

default.description: Existing raw HTTP error envelope. Known local codes and forwarded Core codes are not a closed enum; unknown/empty codes must remain fail-closed.

202.description: Preparation accepted/pending. This is not activation or funding. No-store.

post.description:
Resume only an existing immutable intent. The strict4KiB handler owns
 tenant-body matching and manual-replan conditional validation.

default.description: Existing raw HTTP code envelope; not a Kratos reason envelope or an exhaustive code set.

post.description:
Claim the normal configured one-time free grant for an eligible prepared
 tenant. This shares the strict4KiB/auth owner, never a new funding API.

default.description: Existing raw HTTP code envelope; unknown codes are not successes.

BillingComplianceErrorReason.description: Reasons returned by the BillingCompliance service: values of the proto enums dify.saas.api.billing.CommonErrorReason and dify.saas.api.billing.BillingComplianceErrorReason, plus the reasons emitted by Kratos itself: CODEC and VALIDATOR (400), UNKNOWN (500, recovered panic) and an empty string (500, unclassified error).

BillingEducationErrorReason.description: Reasons returned by the BillingEducation service: values of the proto enums dify.saas.api.billing.CommonErrorReason and dify.saas.api.billing.BillingEducationErrorReason, plus the reasons emitted by Kratos itself: CODEC and VALIDATOR (400), UNKNOWN (500, recovered panic) and an empty string (500, unclassified error).

BillingInvoiceErrorReason.description: Reasons returned by the BillingInvoice service: values of the proto enums dify.saas.api.billing.CommonErrorReason and dify.saas.api.billing.BillingInvoiceErrorReason, plus the reasons emitted by Kratos itself: CODEC and VALIDATOR (400), UNKNOWN (500, recovered panic) and an empty string (500, unclassified error).

BillingModelProviderErrorReason.description: Reasons returned by the BillingModelProvider service: values of the proto enums dify.saas.api.billing.CommonErrorReason and dify.saas.api.billing.BillingModelProviderErrorReason, plus the reasons emitted by Kratos itself: CODEC and VALIDATOR (400), UNKNOWN (500, recovered panic) and an empty string (500, unclassified error).

BillingQuotaErrorReason.description: Reasons returned by BillingQuota: CommonErrorReason and BillingQuotaErrorReason, plus CODEC/VALIDATOR, UNKNOWN and an empty unclassified reason.

BillingSubscriptionErrorReason.description: Reasons returned by the BillingSubscription service: values of the proto enums dify.saas.api.billing.CommonErrorReason and dify.saas.api.billing.BillingSubscriptionErrorReason, plus the reasons emitted by Kratos itself: CODEC and VALIDATOR (400), UNKNOWN (500, recovered panic) and an empty string (500, unclassified error).

BillingSubscriptionPlan.description: Subscription plan and billing cycle info

BillingTokenerErrorReason.description: Known reasons from BillingTokener and CommonErrorReason plus framework reasons. Bootstrap can normalize a new upstream reason; unknown reasons remain failures. HTTP status belongs to the actual operation/error path, not this reason-only enum.

status.description:
pending means the caller should retry; ready means the credential and
 trial grant are both usable.

data_plane_api_key.description: Returned only when status=ready. This value is never persisted by billing.

reason.description: Error reason. The possible values for an operation are listed in the dify.saas.api.billing.<Service>ErrorReason schema of its service, where <Service> is the operationId prefix before the underscore.

Error.description: Kratos error body. Raw Tokener migration HTTP operations explicitly use their separate code-string envelope.

result.description:
True when the account has an education identity that has not expired yet. False when it has
 none or its latest identity has expired.

expire_at.description:
Expiry of the account's latest education identity, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp
 (for example `2027-10-30T08:00:00Z`). `1997-01-01T00:00:00Z` when the account has no education identity.

allow_refresh.description:
True when the latest education identity expires within the configured number of refresh days
 before or after now. False when the account has no education identity.

can_redeem_discount.description: True when the account has an active education identity and has not redeemed its discount in any workspace during the current verification period.

KnowledgeRateLimit.description:
Knowledge rate limit (requests per minute)
 NOTE: size is retained for structural consistency but is not consumed by dify.
 Implementation should populate 0 for paid users.

reserved_amount.description: Amount held by THIS reservation, never the aggregate reserved balance.

capped.description: Explicit legacy message-tail semantics. Default remains strict reservation.

SubscriptionQuota.description: Generic usage quota (size = current usage, limit = max allowed)

status.description:
available means the two counters below are present. unavailable is a
 degraded usage-rollup read and must never be rendered as zero.

start_date.description:
Inclusive UTC range. billed_usd_micro is the amount Tokener has accounted
 through end_date; it must not be added to balance as an old-style quota.

manual.description: The shared legacy handler accepts explicit zero values, never recovery controls.

billing_preparation_ref.description: Accepted for compatibility; the owner always derives/overwrites this value.

data_plane_api_key.description: One-time credential; consumers must not include it in repr/errors/logs.

tenant_id.description: Omitted/empty, or exactly the path tenant; the raw handler checks matching.

operation_id.description: A UUID is required when manual_replan=true; manual must then also be true.

TokenerTenantBootstrapPayload.description:
body: "payload" keeps the external JSON flat while preserving the path
 tenant_id separately, allowing the service to reject path/body mismatches.

available_usd_micro.description:
Signed decimal micro-USD string. It can be negative when the wallet owes
 credit after a dispute or adjustment.

allowance.description: Omitted when the tenant has no active allowance; it is not a zero allowance.

VectorSpaceQuota.description: Vector space quota (size is double because dataset sizes are fractional MB)

token.description: Verification token to pass to CreateEducationIdentity. Empty when status is `not_eligible`.

status.description:
`eligible`: the account email matches an education institution domain and `token` is set.
 `not_eligible`: the account email matches no education institution domain and `token` is empty.
